content:
Upgrading to a new phone often comes with a hidden cost: needing a new case when the new and old iPhones are different sizes.

For users upgrading from last year's Pro model to the iPhone 18 Pro, it looked like a new case would almost certainly be necessary—but two accessory makers disagree, and one of them is putting significant money behind that prediction...

Bloomberg's Mark Gurman posted a photo of an Otterbox case on Twitter, saying it's already available at Best Buy and is compatible with both the iPhone 17 Pro and the iPhone 18 Pro. The bottom right corner of the packaging reads in English and French:

for iPhone 18 Pro iPhone 17 Pro

Gurman himself wasn't entirely convinced, adding "a bit early." However, Matt Ronge of Astropad—who makes anti-glare screen protectors for iPhones—said his suppliers told him the same thing.

Conflicting reports on iPhone Pro thickness

Last year, a leaker suggested that at least the iPhone 18 Pro Max would be thicker and heavier than its predecessor. That report didn't mention the smaller Pro model, but materials from an iPhone supplier indicated that the iPhone 18 Pro would be two millimeters thicker than the previous generation.

This trend appears to be continuing, as both iPhone 17 Pro models are already thicker and heavier than their predecessors.

Not all leakers agree, however—one said the iPhone 18 Pro Max would be exactly the same thickness as last year's model.

9to5Mac's take

Apple does sometimes provide case manufacturers it works with with dimensional information ahead of time, so third-party cases can launch alongside the new iPhone. On the other hand, accessory makers have also been known to place production orders based purely on rumors, and sometimes they're wrong. Personally, I wouldn't order a case before seeing the new iPhone officially announced.
